subject: POC planning: scope, owners, and exec readout timing
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@medsys.com>, John Hsu <john.hsu@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC discovery — recap and proposed next steps

Hi Lisa / John —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight plan so we can get to a meaningful readout quickly: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary use case: clinical notes summarization + clinician QA routing.
- Success metrics you care about: precision on flagged summaries >= 92%, mean summary length ~120–160 tokens, latency target <= 450ms p50.
- Data/access asks: sample of anonymized notes, SSO (SAML) for users, and retention policy details.

Proposed trial (high level):
1) Kickoff: technical onboarding + test dataset ingest.
2) 3-week evaluation window with weekly checkpoints (functions smoke tests, quality sample sets).
3) Final readout + exec decision (go/no-go) with a short SOW if we proceed.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood primary: Marissa Cole (trial owner, onboarding), Karthik Iyer (SE lead)
- MedSys primary: Lisa Turner (product sponsor), John Hsu (platform / infra)

Immediate asks from us:
- Can you confirm the three success metrics above or suggest edits?
- Who will be the technical owner for account provisioning / SSO at MedSys?
- Do you prefer a 2- or 3-week trial? We recommend 3 weeks for robust signal.

I attached a short POC scope doc (POC-scope-v1.pdf) that puts the above in a one-pager. If that looks good we’ll schedule a 30–45m kickoff next week and lock an exec readout slot for the week of June 21.

Thanks —

Logan Wright
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: POC-scope-v1.pdf (3 pages, PDF)

From: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@medsys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Hsu <john.hsu@medsys.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 17:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood POC discovery — recap and proposed next steps

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side:

- Success metrics: the precision target is spot on; please add an operational metric: "% of summaries that require manual correction" and we'd like that < 8% by end of trial.
- Trial length: 3 weeks works for us.
- Technical owner for SSO: that's Nina Patel (CC'ed on this thread). She'll coordinate with our IdP team.

We will need a short data processing addendum as part of the SOW (PII handling / retention). Also please confirm what logs/audit capabilities Redwood provides — we will want a short summary (SOC2 controls + retention window).

We can do a kickoff the week of June 14; prefer mornings ET. Final readout for execs — we can commit to an initial slot on June 23 afternoon ET if that works for your execs.

Thanks,
Lisa Turner
Senior PM, Clinical Data Initiatives
MedSys
lisa.turner@medsys.com

Thanks Lisa — great, appreciate the precision callout. Quick answers / notes: 

- Operational metric: we'll include "% manual correction" in the evaluation plan and collect during weekly checkpoints.
- Security/audit: attaching a short SOC2 controls summary (MAL-SOC2-Summary.pdf) and a one-page retention options matrix.
- SSO / provisioning: Nina — we’ll send a short SAML flow doc and a test IdP connector; Marissa will be the contact for account setup.

Proposed timeline (confirmed):
- 6/14: Kickoff (tech onboarding, test data ingest)
- Weeks of 6/14–6/28: 3-week evaluation; weekly checkpoints on 6/18 and 6/25
- 6/23: Exec readout (MedSys execs + our leadership) — please confirm if you want a 30 or 45 minute slot

POC owners (finalized):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (trial owner), Karthik Iyer (SE lead), Monica Patel (integration/ingest lead)
- MedSys: Lisa Turner (product), John Hsu (platform), Nina Patel (IdP/SSO)

Action items from Redwood before kickoff:
- Send SAML test connector + setup doc (Karthik)
- Share SOC2 + retention summary (attached)
- Deliver trial runbook and checklist (Marissa / Monica)

I attached the SOC2 summary and will loop our security contact if the team needs a deeper review. If the above looks right I’ll put a calendar hold on 6/14 for a 45-minute kickoff and a tentative exec readout for 6/23 3pm ET.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAL-SOC2-Summary.pdf (2 pages, PDF)

I can be primary trial owner for MedSys. Quick checklist and who owns what before the 6/14 kickoff: 

- Data ingest / test dataset: Monica to coordinate with MedSys platform for secure drop (S3 presigned / secure FTP) — owner: Monica Patel
- Account provisioning / SSO testing: Karthik to run SAML connector and validate with Nina — owner: Karthik Iyer

- Health checks / monitoring: daily job to push token/latency metrics to shared dashboard (we'll add MedSys view) — owner: Monitored by infra team, Marissa as contact

Deliverables by EOD 6/13: trial-runbook.md, onboarding checklist, and evaluation templates. I expect we can turn these around tomorrow; attaching the runbook draft for visibility.

If anything in the runbook needs to be shortened for an exec-friendly readout, tell me and I’ll produce a 1-pager.
